answer: Proof of replication. Agents storing tundra imagery, violet spectra, or prism calibration files commit to an account-specific encoding of the archive. Random audits require Merkle-authenticated blocks before a deadline that makes reconstructing a missing replica infeasible. N rewarded accounts therefore require N replicas and their storage costs. This relies on an encoding that resists compression and fast regeneration, plus audits frequent enough to catch deleted data before payment.
